newsitem.title: USA: California budget talks resume - officials.
newsitem.headline: California budget talks resume - officials.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson and leaders of the state Senate and Assembly are meeting Monday in an effort to end to state's budget standoff.

Welfare reform legislation has been the major stumbling block for lawmakers negotiating the state's spending plan for the 1997-1998 fiscal year, which began July 1. The state's Constitutional budget deadline was June 15.
Wilson and legislative leaders met over the weekend but failed to reach an agreement. State officials said they did not expect a breakthrough during Monday's session.
The state's final budget was expected to be in the $67 billion to $70 billion range.
